title: Clambering down to the footpace
html_source:
Stephen pictures himself as a priest moving from the altar to the raised section surrounding the altar indicated by the preceding ‘see him me’.

This sentence contrasts with the next and illustrates the challenging nature of Stephen’s thoughts. Here, he is thinking himself as a priest in not too attractive terms- clambering, grey, bald. The next sentence is an assertive go at male priesthood, ‘tonsured, oiled and gelded’ and distinctly out with his own psyche.
